name: image-project-scope
goal: Prevent a design image read from returning a previous project image after the selected project changes during asynchronous work

evidence: ProjectImageCacheService.read awaits catalog, cache and planning operations but relies on a project identity checked only at entry; identity() also obtains the current project after the first await. A direct read can outlive a session switch.

The existing registered image-reader method case covers ownership, corrupt cache, options and hashes while the selected project stays fixed. Strengthen the same case with controlled cache-hit and provider-free image-read delays across real session.open calls.

At 5eec62c6 both cache-hit and fresh image reads returned previous-project bytes, and the fresh read cached bytes after a real project switch. Clean-snapshot red record 653907fc3bbdbf4dac9fe56c06ff0ad63a8e413d139b8ebb9ee7a519d36dd3e1.
At 5ace9cac the reader captures the original project identity for cache keys and rechecks selected services after asynchronous reads and before returning or initiating a cache write.
The unchanged method case passed at 5ace9cac in the same other-laptop snapshot environment. Green record 83495af08c63012aed480cd25e9b99ca024e1699c68f93b661fb279c1096aede references the recorded red.
